Path 3, costGOALS §10.4

OpenCost

Cost allocation per namespace, label and team, CNCF-native.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF project that allocates cluster spend (compute, storage, network) to Kubernetes objects using cloud billing and on-prem rate cards.

WHAT SETS IT APART

An open specification, vendor-neutral, works on-prem. ArgoCon showed it inside the Argo CD UI, so cost shows up at deploy time rather than in a monthly report.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial after tag and label discipline; without labels every cost tool draws the same unattributable chart.

ArgoCon cost intelligence; "From Packets to Paychecks" (Adobe), KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

OpenCost: Cost allocation per namespace, label and team, CNCF-native. Where we stand: Trial after tag and label discipline; without labels every cost tool draws the same unattributable chart. Cost at the point of deploy changes behaviour; a monthly FinOps deck doesn't.
